description: Service class implementing shopping cart operations such as retrieving, adding, updating, removing, and clearing items in a user's cart within a Spring Boot application.

classes.name: CartService
classes.description: Service class providing core shopping cart functionalities including retrieval, modification, and clearing of cart items for authenticated users.

methods.name: getCurrentUserCart
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user's cart as a DTO, creating a new cart if none exists.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds specified product and quantity to the current user's cart, creating a cart if necessary, and handling stock and availability checks.

methods.name: updateCartItemQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific cart item, removing it if the quantity is set to zero or less, with stock validation.

methods.name: removeFromCart
methods.description: Removes a specific item from the current user's cart.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Clears all items from the current user's cart.
